Name: 1.5 - Stardew Furniture
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
Have you ever went into an NPC's house and looked around and were like "wow I wish I could use the stuff they had scattered around" ? 

Well now you can! At least a good majority of it anyways. This Custom Furniture pack adds 340 individual furniture items (paintings, decorations, tables, etc...) for you to use to decorate your farm! 

[i]Important Note:

CF has some weird limitations and stuff as to how you can use decorations and what not. For some reason you can't place stuff on tables, it doesn't appear. You also can't set hitboxes for the middle of something instead of at the left corner, so for some of the three tile wide trees they are just three tiles wide and you can't walk under them, unfortunately. Those things are not bugs, rather just things I literally cannot fix. [/i]

I went through and placed everything and checked the rotations so it all should be good! I hope you enjoy decorating! 

This should be compatible with all other furniture mods including the ones I've made, though I have a weird thing where all the custom furniture I've placed gets shuffled around like the JSON shuffle when I add a new furniture mod, so be wary of that!


Huge thanks to Elizabeth who wrote this python converter code! 
[url=https://github.com/elizabethcd/FurnitureConverter]Link to Converter

[/url]
[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b]
